channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Argentina market survey cuts 2026 growth forecast, sees stable inflation
item.description: Forty-seven analysts slashed Argentina's 2026 GDP forecast to 2.1%, less than half the government's budget target, while projecting stable monthly inflation through early 2027.

item.title: Judge extends block on USPS mail ballot rules ahead of midterms
item.description: A federal judge's indefinite block on USPS mail-ballot rules sets up a Supreme Court showdown with November approaching fast.

item.title: Argentina faces host Poland as 2026 U-20 Women's World Cup opens
item.description: The 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup kicked off September 5 in Poland, with host Poland taking on Argentina in Katowice.

item.title: Hybrid and electric car sales in Argentina surge 177% year-on-year in August
item.description: Argentina registered 7,656 electrified vehicles in August 2026, a 177% year-on-year jump driven by a zero-tariff decree on imported models.

item.title: Trump administration uses FEMA space for hearings, tells judges to cut case delays
item.description: The administration is converting FEMA conference space for immigration hearings and directing judges to limit delays, according to reporting by The Washington Post and the Guardian.

item.title: MAGA Inc. spends $10 million on Texas Senate ads for Paxton
item.description: A $10 million super-PAC commitment in Texas reveals how structural money gaps and Trump's midterm ambitions are converging in a single Senate race.

item.title: USMCA review pressures Mexico on labor, trade and dairy
item.description: The USMCA's first formal review is reshaping labor rules, dairy trade, and diplomatic strategy across North America.

item.title: Mexico ranks fourth globally in tourism economic contribution
item.description: Mexico's travel and tourism sector added $149.4 billion directly to GDP in 2025, landing the country fourth worldwide behind the U.S., China, and Germany.

item.title: Gallup shows Democratic party-ID lead as Hispanic voter warnings mount
item.description: A Gallup survey shows Democrats opening a six-point party-ID lead, even as strategists warn the socialism label threatens the party's standing with Hispanic voters.

item.title: Supreme Court restores discounted TV ad rates for party committees
item.description: A Supreme Court emergency order over TV ad discount rates opens a window onto how broadcast law, campaign finance, and electoral competition quietly intertwine.

item.title: Kennedy Center ceiling collapses, board renews call to close for renovations
item.description: A section of ceiling fell in the Grand Foyer during a Friday rainstorm, prompting renewed calls from the Kennedy Center board to close for renovations.

item.title: Fired border enforcer Bovino says Trump team not tough enough on deportations
item.description: Former Border Patrol commander-at-large Greg Bovino says the Trump administration fell short of its mass deportation promises and forced him out before he could finish the job.

item.title: US sanctions Cuba entities and Castro grandson, embassy issues health alert
item.description: The Trump administration sanctioned five Cuban entities and a Castro grandson on September 3, one day before the U.S. Embassy in Havana issued a health alert.

item.title: Trump threatens trade halt unless Fed cuts interest rates
item.description: President Trump threatened on Truth Social to halt trade with deficit nations unless the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates from their current 3.5% to 3.75% range.

item.title: Epyca warns global financial tightening threatens Argentina's debt and exports
item.description: Argentine consultancy Epyca says the collapse of a decades-old global financing arrangement puts Argentina's $40 billion debt pile and commodity exports at direct risk.

item.title: Cruz Azul vs Santos Laguna kickoff moved; Erik Lira stays at club
item.description: Liga MX moved the Cruz Azul–Santos kickoff three hours earlier to clear the airwaves for the Leagues Cup final in Houston.

item.title: Messi set to start as Inter Miami host Atlanta United
item.description: Messi starts Saturday after a four-goal, one-assist performance against Montréal as second-place Inter Miami host 27th-place Atlanta United.

item.title: Argentina opens U20 Women's World Cup against host Poland in Katowice
item.description: Poland and Argentina kicked off the 24-team tournament in Katowice on September 5, with FIFA's leadership crisis hovering over the opening ceremony.

item.title: Woodside and PEMEX sign MOU to expand Mexico deepwater partnership
item.description: The two companies already share the $7.2 billion Trion deepwater project and now want to find more Gulf of Mexico prospects together.

item.title: August jobs report adds 162,000, women take nearly all gains
item.description: The August jobs report vastly exceeded forecasts, but women captured nearly all gains while wage growth hit its slowest pace in five years.

item.title: GOP candidates quietly distance from Trump ahead of November midterms
item.description: At least seven GOP House candidates have quietly scrubbed Trump references from campaign websites even as the former president plans a massive midterm spending blitz.

item.title: Trump grants clemency to 30 people, including Roc Nation's Emory Jones
item.description: White House pardon czar Alice Marie Johnson announced the clemency actions on social media Friday, describing recipients as carefully reviewed deserving individuals.

item.title: Latino voters grow independent as Valadao faces shifting district
item.description: Polling shows Latino party identification shifting toward independent status as Rep. David Valadao navigates a redrawn district with a 16-point Democratic registration edge.

item.title: Mexico women's U-20 side opens World Cup against Benin
item.description: Mexico opens its U-20 Women's World Cup campaign against debutant Benin in Katowice, Poland, with 21 players and a Round of 16 to improve on.

item.title: Colombia earthquake's economic toll debated as US aid pledged
item.description: Economists split on how hard Colombia's 7.4-magnitude quake will hit growth as the U.S. commits $20 million and a $1 billion aid package moves forward.

item.title: US strikes three Iranian oil tankers after Navy ships targeted
item.description: A missile exchange and three struck tankers raise old questions about escalation, economic warfare, and where the line between signal and conflict actually sits.

item.title: Inter Miami hosts Atlanta United in MLS regular season clash
item.description: Messi leads MLS scoring with 18 goals as defending champion Inter Miami hosts struggling Atlanta United in their 20th all-time meeting.

item.title: Vance claims Hormuz oil flow near pre-war levels as analysts dispute figures
item.description: VP Vance and President Trump cited single-day figures suggesting a near-full recovery in Hormuz traffic, while shipping trackers reported exports still 7–8 million barrels per day below pre-war levels.

item.title: Petrobras Q2 record output drives 2026 Ibovespa rally, then pause
item.description: Petrobras hit 3.34 million barrels per day in Q2 2026, lifted Brazil's benchmark index to a multi-month high, then watched it slip 1% the next session.

item.title: Uruguay names strong squad for Asia tour and India friendly
item.description: Diego Forlán names 46 players for friendlies against Japan, South Korea, and India, with the Kolkata match set for October 6.

item.title: Record remittances reach Jalisco but families see little quality-of-life gain
item.description: Jalisco pulled in $1.29 billion in Q2 2026, but peso appreciation and inflation slashed real purchasing power by nearly 19% for recipient households.

item.title: Turning Point Action builds 2028 primary infrastructure in Iowa
item.description: Turning Point Action is seeding staff across Iowa's 99 counties and expanding into early primary states ahead of the 2028 Republican nominating contest.

item.title: Caputo touts Argentina as model country, pledges tax cuts ahead of 2027 elections
item.description: Economy Minister Luis Caputo promises a one-point GDP tax cut in 2027 and says Argentina's financial program through that year is fully funded.

item.title: Judge allows alienation-of-affection suit against Sinema to proceed
item.description: A federal judge ruled September 5 that former Sen. Kyrsten Sinema faces trial under North Carolina's alienation-of-affection law over her relationship with a married security staffer.

item.title: White House launches arcade games promoting Trump immigration agenda
item.description: The White House's new arcade platform reveals something older and stranger than a publicity stunt — a government experimenting with the grammar of play.

item.title: ECB and Brazil's central bank explore linking Pix to TIPS
item.description: The ECB and Brazil's central bank are testing whether Pix and TIPS can be linked, with a pilot possibly launching in June 2028.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner arrive in Moscow, headed next to Kyiv
item.description: Trump's envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner landed in Moscow Saturday carrying a peace proposal, with a Kyiv visit planned for Sunday.

item.title: Melania Trump to skip GOP's first-ever midterm convention in Dallas
item.description: A White House official confirmed Melania Trump will not attend the two-day Republican National Committee midterm convention in Dallas next week.

item.title: Savannah Hispanic Chamber announces 2026 Heritage Month fall events
item.description: The Metropolitan Savannah Hispanic Chamber of Commerce has unveiled its Hispanic Heritage Month and fall signature events lineup for 2026.

item.title: Missouri asks US Supreme Court to reinstate new congressional map
item.description: Missouri's redistricting fight lands at the Supreme Court, raising enduring questions about who gets to draw the lines of political power.
